pages.title: IRON NEST Medals - 26 IDs, 162 Tier Conditions Compared
pages.description: Compare 26 medal IDs across 54 medal slots and 162 bronze, silver and gold conditions, while both unresolved duplicate definitions remain visible for audit.
pages.source_unique_value_statement: 集中解释26个被真实任务引用的奖章ID如何换算成54个任务奖章槽和162个铜银金门槛，并同时展示两个重复ID的双版本证据而不伪选权威值。
